`npm test` fails with `TLS_REQUIRED` after the database upgrade: `src/db.ts` still sets `sslmode=disable` because the old proxy terminated TLS. Make the client require TLS. The pool size, acquire timeout and startup migrations must not change. Run `npm test` when done. Keep code changes to `src/` and documentation to the knowledge lake; do not change the pool size, acquire timeout or startup migrations, or modify any other tracked file.
